Pressure, temperature, and density obey the ideal gas law. Other properties are functions of temperature, specified as tabulated data corresponding to the Temperature vector. Entrained water droplets are assumed to be small particles that contribute enthalpy to the energy balance but not to any other properties.

description: This block represents a hard stop that restricts the relative angle of two bodies to greater than or equal to 0 rad. Contact between the two bodies is modeled either as a continuous spring and damper or as an instantaneous impulse based on a coefficient of restitution. The spring-damper hard stop model can apply full stiffness and damping at the bound, or the torque can be applied smoothly through a transition region. The instantaneous impact hard stop model lets the two bodies remain in contact if contact is reached at a relative rotational velocity smaller than the static contact speed threshold. The bodies remain in contact until a torque greater than the static contact release torque threshold is applied. Connections B and F are angle-based rotational conserving ports. Relative angle, the angle of port F relative to port B, is less than or equal to zero when the hard stop is engaged. Torque acts from port B on port F. Positive torque drives port F in the positive direction and corresponds to an engaged hard stop.
